verdict.rationale: Docs mention Marlin is offered as a pay-per-use tier alongside Pro/Team/Enterprise plans and that credits are consumed even if you cancel mid-run, giving a researcher a rough sense of the billing model. However, no actual price points, credit costs, or explicit usage limits (e.g., how many runs, credit caps) are disclosed anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: concrete pricing tiers/dollar amounts, credit-to-cost conversion, explicit usage limits or caps, and any independent corroboration of these terms.
